elements.element: The liability cap applies mutually to each Party.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies to “each Party's total aggregate liability” and expressly states that the cap is mutual.

elements.element: The fee-based limb of the cap equals fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 uses “the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement in the 12 months preceding the claim.”

elements.element: The cap is the greater of the 12-month fee-based limb and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 expressly caps liability at the greater of limb (a) and “(b) USD 1,000,000.”

elements.element: Indirect damages are excluded mutually.
elements.evidence: Section 21.2 provides that “neither Party” is liable for indirect damages, subject to the stated Excluded Claims and legal-excludability qualifications.

elements.element: Consequential damages are excluded mutually.
elements.evidence: Section 21.2 provides that “neither Party” is liable for consequential damages, subject to the stated Excluded Claims and legal-excludability qualifications.

elements.element: Each Party's breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Confidentiality breaches are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3, and Section 21.1 excludes all Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Each Party's breach of data-protection obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Data-protection breaches are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3, and Section 21.1 excludes all Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Each Party's breach of security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Security breaches are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3, and Section 21.1 excludes all Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Each Party's indemnification obligations are uncapped.
elements.evidence: Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3, and Section 21.1 excludes all Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Each Party's gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Gross negligence is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3, and Section 21.1 excludes all Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Each Party's wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Wilful misconduct is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3, and Section 21.1 excludes all Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Each Party's fraud is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Fraud is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3, and Section 21.1 excludes all Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Each Party's infringement of the other Party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3, and Section 21.1 excludes all Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not damages for purposes of the liability cap.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 states that Customer's obligation to pay amounts due under the Agreement is not damages and is not limited by Section 21.

elements.element: The liability cap applies mutually to each Party.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies to “each Party's total aggregate liability” and expressly states that the cap is mutual.

elements.element: The liability cap equals 12 months' fees.
elements.evidence: The operative cap is the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, not a cap equal solely to 12 months' fees. Whenever 12 months' fees are below USD 1,000,000, the cap differs from the fallback formula.

elements.element: Each Party's indemnification obligations are uncapped.
elements.evidence: Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3 and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Each Party's breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Confidentiality breaches are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3 and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Each Party's gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Gross negligence is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Each Party's wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Wilful misconduct is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.

result.reason: The rendered language fully implements the preferred position: it creates the required mutual greater-of cap, preserves mutual indirect and consequential-damages exclusions, leaves every required carve-out uncapped, and places Customer amounts due outside damages and the cap. The changes are confined to the cap calculation, its temporal trigger, and the payment-obligation treatment. The fallback is separately not satisfied because its stated cap is exactly 12 months' fees, whereas the rendered clause adds a USD 1,000,000 floor. Drafting quality is reduced because lowercase “fees” is used alongside the defined capitalized term “Fees,” creating avoidable interpretive ambiguity over whether the defined USD 12,000 amount controls.
